reasoning: We prioritized findings that actively lie on the attack paths leading from the internet to the crown jewel bucket (org_a:ds:00001). Using attack path analysis and min-cut calculations, we identified the specific entry-point vulnerabilities and cloud keys that allow attackers to traverse the network. Remediating this minimal set of findings and revoking the exposed cloud credential fully disconnects all internet-based attack routes to the crown jewels.
